column3: a lazy chunk that fails to fetch reloads the page once with ?stale=<ms> (web/src/lib/stale-chunk.ts), centrally from vite:preloadError in main.tsx and from the lazyView and loadUiSdk catches; it declines within 10 minutes of the last such reload, while offline, or while a composer holds an unsent draft, and then the in-place Stopped/Try again or retry-on-next-press runs
column4: XIN-33 live run: a tab open across a redeploy asks for combobox-<old hash>.js, which is gone, so every in-place retry 404s forever; only a fresh index.html names the new hashes. The guard is a timestamp rather than the ?boot= presence check #116 uses (and strips after boot, so it is kept for #116 alone) so a tab that reloaded once can still recover from the next deploy hours later. There is no persisted draft store (lib/draft.ts is an in-memory hand-off), so an unsent draft holds the reload instead of being saved. Only fetch-failure messages reload, so a module that throws while evaluating fails in place
